name: Payment Gateway for Razorpay and for WooCommerce
author: Easy Payment

sections.description:
Payment Gateway for Razorpay and WooCommerce enables merchants to accept online payments through Razorpay UPI, Razorpay Cards, Razorpay Net Banking, and Razorpay Wallets directly on their WooCommerce store.

This plugin is developed by Easy Payment, an official Razorpay partner. With Razorpay for WooCommerce by Easy Payment, your store can offer customers fast, reliable, and secure checkout with UPI, Cards, Wallets, and Net Banking powered by Razorpay Checkout.

Razorpay is India’s most trusted payment provider. By integrating Razorpay UPI with WooCommerce, you give customers the easiest way to pay while ensuring PCI DSS compliant transactions.

Key Features

  • Razorpay UPI Payments – Accept UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, and BHIM UPI.
  • Razorpay Cards – Accept Debit and Credit Cards via Razorpay.
  • Razorpay Net Banking – Payments through supported Indian banks.
  • Razorpay Wallets – Enable wallet payments through Razorpay.
  • Razorpay for WooCommerce by Easy Payment – Built by an official Razorpay Partner.
  • Real-Time Razorpay Updates – WooCommerce order status updated automatically.
  • Secure Razorpay Checkout – PCI DSS Level 1 compliant transactions.
  • Quick Setup – Just enter Razorpay API Key and Secret.

Why Choose Razorpay for WooCommerce by Easy Payment?

  1. Razorpay UPI Advantage – Boost conversions with faster UPI payments.
  2. Trusted Razorpay Brand – Millions of businesses in India use Razorpay.
  3. Fewer Cart Abandonments – Razorpay Checkout is optimized for speed.
  4. Quick Settlements – Razorpay ensures fast payouts to merchants.
  5. Official Razorpay Partner Plugin – Built by Easy Payment with full support.

👉 Note: Razorpay only supports Indian merchants and INR currency.

How It Works

  1. Install & Activate the plugin.
  2. Go to WooCommerce → Settings → Payments → Razorpay.
  3. Enter your Razorpay API Key & Secret.
  4. Enable Razorpay as a payment option.
  5. Customers can pay via Razorpay UPI, Razorpay Cards, Razorpay Net Banking, and Razorpay Wallets.

That’s it — your WooCommerce store is now powered by Razorpay for WooCommerce by Easy Payment 🎉

External Services

This plugin integrates with Razorpay services for payment processing and merchant onboarding:

  • https://checkout.razorpay.com/v1/checkout.js – Razorpay Checkout form.
  • https://api.razorpay.com/v1/ – Razorpay orders, payments, and webhooks.
  • https://rzp.io/ – Razorpay merchant onboarding.

Data Shared with Razorpay:
– Customer details: Name, email, phone, billing/shipping address.
– Payment details: Order ID, amount, currency.
– Merchant onboarding: Email, phone, and business details.

Service Provider: Razorpay Software Private Limited

sections.faq:
Does this plugin support UPI in WooCommerce?

Yes! This plugin supports Razorpay UPI in WooCommerce. Customers can pay using Razorpay UPI apps like Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, and BHIM UPI.

Do I need a Razorpay account?

Yes. You need a Razorpay merchant account to use this plugin.
Sign up here.

Is “Razorpay for WooCommerce by Easy Payment” free?

Yes. The plugin is free. Razorpay charges its standard UPI, Card, and Net Banking fees.

Is Razorpay secure?

Yes. Razorpay is PCI DSS Level 1 certified, ensuring secure payments for UPI, Cards, and Net Banking.

Can I use Razorpay outside India?

No. Razorpay only supports merchants registered in India and INR currency.

Will Razorpay slow down my site?

No. This plugin is lightweight, optimized, and Razorpay Checkout loads quickly.
